science.qualification: The measured shadow drawn as a black disc that always faces the viewer. A display convention; not an event horizon, a surface or a measured colour. No lighting. Around it, on the off-limb plate, the EHT's 1.3 mm image of 2017 April 7: the mean of 200 reconstructions drawn at random from the 5594 of EHT Sgr A* Paper III's eht-imaging Top Set, on eht-imaging's own display colour map (matplotlib afmhot, linear, sampled at quarter steps), a legend for relative intensity and not a colour.

offLimbContext.source: observations/eht-2017-04-07-topset-mean.fits: the mean of 200 EHT Sgr A* Paper III eht-imaging Top Set reconstructions, 2017 April 7
offLimbContext.composition: the image's light on the display stretch, alpha fading to zero light; the plate covers the image's 150 microarcsecond field at the shadow's scale (496 x 150 / 48.7)
offLimbContext.rotation: celestial north to its screen direction at the default camera

limbMaterial.composition: transparent: the sphere's own silhouette is the limb; the light just outside it is on the off-limb plate
